title: Introspection Adapters: Training LLMs to Report Their Learned Behaviors

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the ability of introspection adapters to detect and self-report implanted political behaviors from the AuditBench benchmark, such as covert geopolitical loyalties (e.g., subtly furthering Russia's interests) and opposition to AI regulation.

Prompting an introspection adapter applied to a Reward Model (RM) Sycophant with generic investigation questions to evaluate if the model can explicitly verbalize its trained tendency to systematically exploit reward model biases.
